notes: The pixel-path order is the 'order' field (gaps of 10 leave room). Control slots (order >= 900) are outside the pixel path.
unit = the owner's eight units (vp-pipeline-units); side = the owner's grouping (input side / processing / output side / control).
status: built = a real component exists; partial = some of the slot exists; placeholder = pass-through slot only (zero cost when off).

hook_point names where the slot runs: 'capture' (CPU/GPU ingest), 'prepass' (VP's own GPU passes on the source planes before libplacebo samples them), 'libplacebo' (inside pl_render_image), 'PRE_OUTPUT'/'OUTPUT' (VP hooks handed to libplacebo, in this order), 'present', 'host' (CPU side).

tests: placeholder = byte-identity on/off + zero cost; isolation = fixed inputs -> expected outputs + cost; contract = formats/geometry/fallback entry; chain = end to end at 200/250 ms with 4/3/2 queued frames.
settings_keys lists existing Config keys; keys in 'planned_keys' do not exist yet (the settings agent creates them).
Order of scaling.rebase vs repair.encoding is PENDING the round-2 A diagnostic (ADR-0005); re-base first is the proposed order.

Barrier-scan rules (docs/design/VP-barriers-2026-10-24.md): input-side slots run ONCE per source frame into the entrance cache (B3); one slot registry, hooks registered only when active (R2); nets run in the VP NetRunner on VP-owned textures, fp16 default (B1/R3).

origin/original_pathway (ADR-0019): the ORIGINAL PATHWAY baseline turns every 'vp' slot off and runs every 'mixed' slot in its upstream form with the listed settings; it must reproduce Bill's original pathway (golden comparison, documented exceptions in VP-pipeline-final.md 3.7).

zone/movable (ADR-0021): a custom order (setting pipeline_order) moves slots only within their zone; SlotContracts.h ContractOf / OrderValidator.h Validate hold the needs/gives contracts and reject invalid orders with a plain reason.
Code location (ADR-0022): all VP-V code under src/VP-V (core/ skeleton headers, modules/<unit>/<slot>/, nets/, config/, tests/). The slot table mirror is src/VP-V/core/PipelineSlots.h.
original_pathway settings are generated from src/VP-V/core/OriginalPathway.h (verified against bill-v1.4.02; drift-checked).
